div.div: 3 المُفَاوَصَةُ signifies The being clear, or perspicuous, syn. البَيَانُ, (S, O, K,) in talk or discourse (فِى الحَدِيثِ). (S. [In the O, and K, مِنَ الحَدِيثِ; and hence it is said in the TK that فَاوَصَ الحَدِيثَ signifies بَيَّنَهُ He made the talk, or discourse, clear, or perspicuous: but for this I do not find any authority.]) Some say المُفَايَصَةُ. (IB, TA in art. فيص.) [See also 4 in art. فيص.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
